whoItsFor: Owners of a gaming PC with an NVIDIA or AMD graphics card (12 GB VRAM or more) and 32 GB or more of RAM, running Windows or Linux, who want a large AI model running privately on their own machine and connected to their apps or coding agents.
useCases: Private local chat and writing, with no data leaving the PC
Connecting apps and coding agents to localhost via OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible APIs
Reading pictures and working through long documents or code

requirements.modelSizes: 125B parameters (quantized variants Q2_0, IQ2_XS, IQ3_XXS, IQ3_S, UD-IQ4_XS, UD-Q4_K_XL, plus Coder)
